FV-AUXLD-1.label: AUXILIARY LOADS - SHIP SERVICES AND HOTEL LOAD 1

FV-PMS-1.label: MAIN SWITCHBOARD AC - POWER MANAGEMENT SYSTEM 1

FV-WASP-2.label: WIND ASSISTED PROPULSION SYSTEM - SUCTION SAIL 2

AC.label: Alternating Current
AC.comment: Classifies an electrical system or component as using alternating current (AC).

AUXLOAD.label: Auxiliary Load
AUXLOAD.comment: Auxiliary electrical loads including ship services and hotel load. Represents the non-propulsion electrical demand on the power management system.

AirLubricationSystem.label: Air Lubrication System
AirLubricationSystem.comment: Reduces hull friction by creating a layer of air bubbles under the hull, improving fuel efficiency.

BidirectionalConverterSystem.label: Bidirectional Converter System
BidirectionalConverterSystem.comment: DC bus bidirectional converter that converts between AC and DC power, enabling charging and discharging of energy storage systems through the main switchboard.

Bow.label: Bow
Bow.comment: Classifies a thruster or maneuvering device as bow-mounted.

BowThruster.label: Bow Thruster
BowThruster.comment: A dedicated bow thruster for vessel maneuvering. Uses existing bow thruster datatype properties.

CPP.label: Controllable Pitch Propeller
CPP.comment: Controllable Pitch Propeller - a propeller where the blade pitch can be adjusted while rotating to optimize thrust and efficiency.

DC.label: Direct Current
DC.comment: Classifies an electrical system or component as using direct current (DC).

DieselElectricConfiguration.label: Diesel-Electric Configuration
DieselElectricConfiguration.comment: Classifies a diesel-electric propulsion configuration where engines drive generators to produce electricity, which then powers electric motors for propulsion. Counterpart to MechanicalConfiguration for conventional direct-drive or geared propulsion.

DynamicWing.label: Dynamic Wing
DynamicWing.comment: Active aerodynamic or hydrodynamic drag reduction device for improving vessel efficiency.

ESD.label: Energy Storage Device
ESD.comment: Classifies a component as an energy storage device, capable of storing and releasing electrical energy.

ElectricMotorShaft.label: Electric Motor Shaft
ElectricMotorShaft.comment: The propulsion shaft connecting an electric motor to a propeller. Carries shaft speed and torque properties.

ElectricMotorSystem.label: Electric Motor System
ElectricMotorSystem.comment: AC electric motor that drives a propeller via a shaft. The diesel-electric equivalent of MainEngineSystem in the propulsion chain.

EnergyStorageSystem.label: Energy Storage System
EnergyStorageSystem.comment: Battery or hybrid energy storage providing peak power, backup, and load balancing for diesel-electric vessels. Connected to the main switchboard via a bidirectional converter.

FrequencyConverterSystem.label: Frequency Converter System
FrequencyConverterSystem.comment: Converts DC/AC electrical power to the frequency needed by electric motors in a diesel-electric propulsion system.

Fuel.label: Fuel
Fuel.comment: Fuel type (e.g., HFO, MGO, MDO). Defined as individuals to allow engines and components to reference specific fuel types via the consume property.

FuelCellSystem.label: Fuel Cell System
FuelCellSystem.comment: Fuel cell system for supplementary or backup power generation. Converts chemical energy from fuel (e.g., ammonia, hydrogen) directly into electrical energy.

GateRudder.label: Gate Rudder
GateRudder.comment: A combined rudder and propulsion enhancement device. Unlike traditional rudders, gate rudders provide both steering and thrust augmentation.

GenSetSystem.label: Generator Set System
GenSetSystem.comment: An integrated engine and generator unit that produces electrical power. The diesel-electric equivalent of MainEngineSystem — its primary purpose is electrical energy production rather than mechanical propulsion. Subclass of EngineSystem because it is physically a diesel engine that consumes fuel and has combustion/shaft properties.

HotelLoad.label: Hotel Load
HotelLoad.comment: Classifies a load as hotel load (HVAC, lighting, galley, passenger comfort systems, etc.).

OSP.label: On Shore Power
OSP.comment: Shore power connection for zero-emission port operations. Allows a vessel to receive electrical power from the shore grid.

Pms.label: PMS
Pms.comment: Power Management System - manages electrical power distribution on a vessel.

RoRo.label: Roll-on/Roll-off
RoRo.comment: Roll-on/Roll-off vessel - a cargo ship designed to carry wheeled cargo that is driven on and off the ship.

SCR.label: Selective Catalytic Reduction
SCR.comment: Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR) system for NOx emissions reduction using a catalytic process.

ShipServices.label: Ship Services
ShipServices.comment: Classifies a load as ship services (navigation, machinery support, safety systems, etc.).

SuctionSail.label: Suction Sail
SuctionSail.comment: Classifies a wind-assisted propulsion system as a suction sail (Flettner rotor or similar technology).

WindAssistedPropulsionSystem.label: Wind Assisted Propulsion System
WindAssistedPropulsionSystem.comment: Wind-assisted propulsion system (WASP) such as suction sails or rotor sails that harness wind energy to supplement vessel propulsion.
